name: tablestudio
description: Your coding agent works on your databases through the TableStudio app: reads run read-only in the database, writes are dry-run against the real rows, production changes go to your review in TableStudio's Agent Center, and the shell can't write to production.

interface.shortDescription: Safe database work through the TableStudio app
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to TableStudio, the native macOS database client. Codex learns which saved connection each of the repo's databases is, dry-runs writes against the real rows, checks new migrations against real data, and sends risky changes to your review inbox in TableStudio. A shell guard stops writes to remote and production databases.
defaultPrompt: Which TableStudio connection is this project's database?
Check my latest migration against the real data before I deploy it.
